results.details: Dependent foreign records in attendance, fee_collections, results, and student_leaves are not cleaned up.

steps: 1. Enroll a new student via /add-student (creates student_id 72, user_id 134, fee voucher 611).
2. Add linked records in attendance, results, and student_leaves.
bugs.expected: Deleting a student must clean up or archive all associated records (fee collections, attendance, results, leaves) in a DB transaction or enforce database cascade constraints.
bugs.actual: Only the student and linked user account are deleted. Related records in fee_collections (voucher #611), attendance, results, and student_leaves remain permanently orphaned with invalid student_id references.
